title: Proppian Villainy / Lack / Mediation
observed_structure: A concrete harm or lack destabilizes the prior order.
Knowledge of that condition reaches an agent and creates an obligation to act.
cinematic_affordances: message or witness that activates action
transferable_structure: Introduce an observable lack or harm, then mediate it to an agent whose choices become causally constrained.
non_transferable_surface: Do not copy folktale roles, quest objects, magical helpers, or culturally specific tale surfaces.
